'''Eberhard Brecht''' (born 20 February 1950) is a German politician. Born in [[Quedlinburg]], [[Saxony-Anhalt]], he represents the [[Social Democratic Party of Germany|SPD]]. Eberhard Brecht has served as a member of the [[Bundestag]] from the state of [[Saxony-Anhalt]] from 1990 till 2001 and since 2019.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.abgeordnetenwatch.de/profile/eberhard-brecht|title=Eberhard Brecht {{!}} Abgeordnetenwatch|website=www.abgeordnetenwatch.de|language=de|access-date=2020-03-19}}</ref>

== Life ==
He was a member of the Volkskammer 1990 and the Bundestag from 1990 to 2001 and since October 2019. From 2001 to 2015 he was Lord Mayor of Quedlinburg.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.spdfraktion.de/abgeordnete/brecht|title=Dr. Eberhard Brecht, MdB|date=2013-09-23|website=SPD-Bundestagsfraktion|language=de|access-date=2020-03-19}}</ref> He is a member of the Defence Committee.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bundestag.de/en/committees/a12|title=German Bundestag – Defence|website=German Bundestag|language=en|access-date=2020-03-19}}</ref>
